subject: financial_literacy
concept: Preparing for a realistic financial setback (job loss, unexpected expense) using an emergency fund and adjusted budget
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Resilience Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student adjusts their own earlier independent-living budget in response to a described financial setback
exercise.abstract: Student explains how they would adjust their finances to weather a realistic setback, using their emergency fund and revised budget

assessment.mastery_threshold: response uses the emergency fund appropriately and makes realistic budget adjustments
misconception_flags: response has no plan beyond hoping the situation resolves itself, with no use of the emergency fund or budget adjustment

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
